properties.name: When a Decision is written or accepted with numbers it does not source, the write's reply says so, and only then
properties.source: Anthony Sligar (who:ajs), 2026-10-11, choosing a smarter option (c) of dec:idea-how-is-a-decision-that-rests-on-numbers-held-to-keeping-its-math: "I like your recommendation of (b) and a smarter (c). let's promote this idea to intent"
properties.statement:
When add_decision writes a Decision, or set_decision_status moves one to accepted, the reply carries a note only when that decision rests on numbers it does not source. That means its text states quantities with units, or it names quantities it rests on, and one or more of them has no provenance or no kept computation linked by documents. The note names the numbers it found and what to do: compute them in a calculator helper if one is connected and link the kept record, or name each one's source. It never refuses the write. A decision with no numbers, or whose numbers are all sourced, gets no note.

WHY "SMARTER": measured 2026-10-11 on reflow2 0.81.1, flo2.io already appends a decision_math note to every add_decision reply, including one for an exploratory idea that rests on no numbers. A note on every write is soon ignored. This note fires only when it is true, so it is read at the one moment the agent can still act. Dates, version numbers, PR and issue numbers, and counts of design nodes are not quantities for this purpose.
